Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:, part of Strand 7 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: What are you doing? What were you doing yesterday? What will you be doing tomorrow?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly is enhanced as they talk about activities

in the past, present, and future time by recognising the value of others.

• Self-efficacy: The learner states what they find difficult to do as they talk about activities in the past, present, and

future time.

Values:
Love: It is cultivated as the learner learns to resolve conflicts while collaborating with peers to determine the

correctness of aspect in sample sentences.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills: Effective communication is achieved as learners engage in role play and retell the events in the story.
